selection_provenance.scope_guard: This record audits only the exact public CAV-Bench release/artifact surface and this run's exposed reproduction path. It does not generalize to all versions, all forks, all external replications, or real-model behavior.

tested_scope.bounded_question: Whether CAV-Bench exposes an immutable official v1.0.0 artifact with sufficiently explicit zero-network reproduction instructions and whether this scheduled-Chat execution surface can independently reproduce the canonical deterministic ablation without Work, protected-primary/manual-user execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or incremental monetary cost.

observations.official_artifact: The public repository is accessible, exposes a v1.0.0 annotated tag that resolves to exact commit 6ec0b25cbc2f9d07ea84853c7a01f10aea31cea6, and documents a version DOI for the immutable v1.0.0 archive.
observations.release_environment_contract: At the exact v1.0.0 release commit, pyproject.toml declares Python >=3.11, core dependency jsonschema>=4,<5, and dev dependencies pytest>=8, pytest-cov>=5, ruff>=0.6, mypy>=1.11, build>=1.2.
observations.release_reproduction_recipe: The exact release docs prescribe clean checkout, editable dev install, pytest, ruff, mypy, build, cavbench doctor, pack validation, and cavbench ablate. They state that core benchmark execution requires no network access and that Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 are supported.
observations.golden_oracle: At the exact release commit, tests/golden/test_canonical_ablation.py hard-codes and recomputes the published five-profile OSR/PAOSR/CVSR/VG table and separately asserts monotonically non-decreasing CVSR as safeguard tiers are added.
observations.local_independent_execution_attempt: A bounded attempt to materialize the exact public repository into the local execution container via git clone failed before checkout because that container could not resolve github.com. No benchmark code or tests executed, so this is a missing execution/materialization capability in this Chat surface, not a failed CAV-Bench reproduction.
observations.bounded_independent_replication_search: A bounded public search for CAV-Bench reproducibility/replication surfaced the official repository and first-party repository issues/docs but did not surface an independent run report in the inspected result set. This is not a global absence claim.
observations.dependency_lock_limit: The release specifies compatible dependency ranges rather than a fully pinned lockfile in pyproject.toml. This does not refute its deterministic benchmark claim, but a strict external replication should record resolved dependency versions in addition to the benchmark's own seven run-identity fields.

reproduction_assessment.reason: The official artifact is unusually reproducibility-friendly: exact release provenance, documented clean-checkout commands, no-network core execution, a deterministic scenario pack, and golden tests are all exposed. However this invocation could not independently execute the release because the local executor lacked network/DNS access and the GitHub connector exposes file/content reads rather than a repository-tree materialization surface. Therefore official support is verified but independent reproduction is not credited.

injected_boundary_checks.missing_tool_condition: Observed: local public-repository materialization via git clone was unavailable because the execution container could not resolve github.com. The connector remained read-capable but did not provide whole-repository local materialization. Classified unresolved rather than pass/fail of the candidate.
injected_boundary_checks.rate_limit_condition: No same-run wait, poll, backoff, or connector retry loop was used.
injected_boundary_checks.invocation_boundary_condition: The audit is checkpointed with exact release commit, exact control authority, exact unresolved reproduction boundary, and a nonempty continuation so a later invocation can resume without repeating the artifact-discovery slice.
injected_boundary_checks.quota_exhaustion_condition: No GitHub Actions, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package allowance, hosted compute/storage allowance, external model/API credit, trial quota, or paid quota was consumed or required by this slice.

continuation: Re-bootstrap current controls and keep CAV-Bench open. Resume only at the unresolved mechanical reproduction boundary: if an actually exposed zero-cost, zero-finite-quota Chat tool can materialize the exact public v1.0.0 tree at commit 6ec0b25cbc2f9d07ea84853c7a01f10aea31cea6 into an executable local filesystem without Work/protected/manual execution, run the documented release gate (pytest, ruff, mypy, build, cavbench doctor, validate core-v1, and cavbench ablate), record exact resolved dependency versions and compare the computed canonical table against tests/golden/test_canonical_ablation.py.
